mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_log l JOIN tb_car c ON l.car_number = c.car_number WHERE c.driver_idx = #{driverIdx}

SELECT l.event_type, l.created_at, l.event_level FROM tb_log AS l JOIN tb_car AS c ON l.car_number = c.car_number JOIN tb_driver AS d ON c.driver_idx = d.driver_idx WHERE d.driver_idx = #{driverIdx} ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
SELECT log_idx, event_type, event_level, event_img1, created_at FROM tb_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
